relations.title: Compare assumptions for intra-tower decays
relations.rationale: Compare the stellar production, cooling and visible-decay questions with the separately scoped KK threshold and cascade analysis. The relation supports examining their assumptions without asserting transfer of the threshold law.
relations.qualification: Compare dimensionality, action, field/brane treatment, daughter-mass and threshold regime. Compatibility is unestablished; no revised stellar bound follows. Cooling and production are distinct from visible-decay constraints. The specified five-dimensional threshold law is not established as applicable here or as a family-wide premise.

originalTransferDecision.title: Pending: establish applicability of the threshold law to stellar KK decays
originalTransferDecision.rationale: A premise check would run from the stellar visible-decay inference to the threshold analysis, reversing the original direction. Both statements require a geometry and decay-regime check, but the packet does not establish the match needed to transfer the suppression result.
originalTransferDecision.qualification: Keep this relation pending without asserting incompatibility or a revised stellar bound. The stellar source spans multiple dimensional settings, while s5 restricts its amplitude claim to a stated five-dimensional scalar–gravity setting and threshold regime. Cooling and production remain separate from later visible-decay limits; only the latter weakening argument invokes dominant intra-tower decays.
originalTransferDecision.missingPremise: It is not established that the stellar-source intra-tower channel relevant to the claimed weakening of visible-decay limits lies within s5's five-dimensional, diffeomorphism-invariant two-derivative scalar–gravity setting, stated field and brane treatment, and near-threshold regime with comparable daughter masses.

independentWithholdingAssessment.reason: Both original statements require a geometry and decay-regime check before transferring threshold suppression to the stellar inference. The supplied scopes do not establish that match. Withholding is justified, and the proposed premise-check orientation is correctly reversed toward s5. The missing premise specifically identifies dimensional, action, field/brane and near-threshold requirements without asserting a revised stellar limit.
